OSM Decals, Oilfield Safety & Marking Solutions is a division of 1st Impression Signs.
Made in-house: WHMIS labels, hard hat stickers, cast vinyl fleet decals, reflective polymetal signs, and coroplast signs.
Shop in the MD of Bonnyville, Alberta. Serves Bonnyville, Cold Lake, St. Paul, Lloydminster, Edmonton, Grande Prairie, Fort McMurray, Alberta, Saskatchewan, and British Columbia.
Contact: sales@osmdecals.ca, (780) 207-3927. Quotes in 24 hours. Production to shipping is 5–10 days.
Minimums: 25 units for 8.5×11 WHMIS labels, 45 for 2.5×2.5 hard hat stickers, 4 for cast vinyl fleet decals, 4 for 18×24 reflective polymetal signs, and 4 for 18×24 coroplast signs.
Product pages: https://www.osmdecals.ca/fleet-truck-decals.html, https://www.osmdecals.ca/whmis-labels.html, https://www.osmdecals.ca/hard-hat-stickers.html, https://www.osmdecals.ca/reflective-signs.html, https://www.osmdecals.ca/coroplast-signs.html.
